messages:
sasha: quick FYI — FP8 kernel enable on canary (h100/l40s) produced a weird bias on randomized-scaling runs. small-batch eval shows +0.7 ppl vs fp32 baseline.

liam: saw that. which model and eval? numbers?

sasha: mosaic-13b (new onboarding). eval-suite/devset-qa, run id canary-005. ppl=23.4 (fp32=22.7). zero-shot EM down ~1.8%. ran 5 seeds, variance larger than usual.

anita: any logs or stack traces? was there a NaN/inf?

sasha: no NaNs. distribution shift only. suspect the "randomized scaling" (rndst) path in the fp8 kernel. quick repro command I used:

```bash
# canary start
./serve --model mosaic-13b --quant fp8 --kernel h100 --seed 42 --batch 1 --canary
```

and snippet from runtime log:

```
[2025-05-14T12:01:02Z] kv_warmup: ok
[2025-05-14T12:01:03Z] rndst_scale applied to layer 6
[2025-05-14T12:01:04Z] endpt_q_err mean=0.0027 std=0.0011
```

liam: can you toggle deterministic scaling? try `--quant-disable-rnd` to rule it out.

sasha: did that — ppl drops back to 22.8 (almost baseline). so rndst looks suspicious. effect is strongest at batch=1 and seq_len>1024.

miguel: sounds like an interaction with KV-cache tiling or continuous-batching. rndst is meant to reduce static bias but can amplify noise over long contexts. can you run per-layer ablation (turn rndst off per-layer)?

anita: also run AWQ/GPTQ/INT8 baselines on the same commit so we know if it's quant-algo specific.

sasha: short results so far: AWQ int8 ppl=22.9, GPTQ ppl=22.95, fp8+rndst ppl=23.4, fp8-no-rndst ppl=22.8.

liam: good. mitigation ideas:
- short-term: disable rndst for canary/rollout when batch < 4 or seq_len > 768.
- medium-term: per-channel scaling and reduce rndst amplitude for matmul-heavy layers (5-8).
- fallback: route those layers to INT8 or FP16 when delta exceeds threshold.

anita: proposal: runtime config `quant.rndst_threshold = {min_batch:4, max_seq:768}` and a canary alert if eval delta > 0.5 ppl. I'll open a PR with the flag and testcases.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy/1753450000 completed: canary traffic 1% -> 0% (auto-rollback triggered by perf-delta). logs: https://ci.internal/1753450000

sasha: thanks. I'll collect per-seed traces and perf counters (tile jitter, scale histograms) and attach. tagging @miguel for kernel follow-up. :thinking:

miguel: on it — will add instrumentation to the rndst path (per-channel scale jitter, seed sensitivity) and a small synthetic test that mimics long-prefix accumulation. ETA EOD.

liam: please also add a small repro notebook and link in the ticket (notebooks/fp8-rndst-repro.ipynb).

sasha: uploaded a gist with commands and raw outputs: https://gist.internal/abcd1234. I'll put the per-layer ablation results there once ready.

anita: thanks team — once we have the per-layer numbers we can decide rollout policy. short-term rollback to `quant.rndst=false` for mosaic-13b canary until kernel patch lands.

miguel: noted — will follow up in this thread with instrumentation PR and perf dumps.
